I really did think that was hilarious and I'd never seen it on any other meter.
And I thought, you know, it's not a showstopper but it's just one of those annoying design quirks and I didn't like it.
And I got a lot of people, quite a few people, complaining that, well, it was a bit harsh and that we shouldn't be poking the buttons.
You should put your finger on the back and do something like that.
Or it's designed as a handheld meter and you shouldn't expect it to, you know, to actually operate the buttons while it's sitting on the bench.
The stand is only to prop the display up. It's not actually for operation.
